name: auto-model-router
description: Per-prompt model routing for Claude Code. A heuristic classifier picks a model tier and effort; when that tier is strictly cheaper than the session's own model, the prompt auto-delegates to a worker subagent. Plan-mode and multi-part prompts fan out into parallel waves with file-conflict safety. Goal-anchored: a usage report scores cost saved against the parent model, user-correction rate, and time-to-results.
